Ben — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. TL;DR: we have three common commit bands for Hosted API customers and a couple of flexible options for startups. I've attached a short spreadsheet that lays out sample pricing and the math for the scenarios you listed.

High-level options (examples):
- Starter band: 250k tokens/mo (no discount, month-to-month) — for very early pilots.
- Growth band: 1M tokens/mo (10% off list) — 3 or 12 month term options.
- Scale band: 5M tokens/mo (20% off list) — typically 6–12 month commits.

Startup support: we can provide pilot credits (50k–200k tokens) and a 60-day evaluation window; we also offer one-time signup credits for qualified Series B startups.

Overage / burst behavior: by default, overages bill at a step rate (list rate) but we support a "flex reserve" add-on (see Monica's note below) that smooths short-term bursts and gives a lower overage/unit rate for reserved burst capacity. Scaling up mid-term is supported — we can increase commit bands and backdate the uplift to the billing period if needed.

I've attached: Redwood_Pricing_Options_Q1_2026.xlsx (sample math + bands).

If that looks useful I can: (a) schedule a 30-minute call with Monica (SE) to walk the numbers and run your forecast, and (b) draft a formal quote and MAP for procurement. Are you available Wed 3/11 10–11am PT or Thu 3/12 1–2pm PT?

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Ben — Monica here (solutions). Quick technical notes to answer the overage and burst questions:

- Overage billing: default behavior is per-token at list rate. However, for customers on Growth/Scale bands we typically tier the overage:
  • 0–100% of commit: included
  • 100–200% of commit: billed at list rate with a step-down of 5–15% depending on negotiated band (we typically offer -10% for Growth/Scale commits)
  • >200% of commit: open-rate (we discuss reservation or Dedicated options if you regularly exceed this)

- Flex reserve (recommended for launch bursts): you reserve a small buffer (e.g., 250k tokens) at a reduced reserve rate. That buffer can be consumed first for bursts and is billed monthly whether used or not — it reduces unpredictable overage cost.

- Example math (simple):
  • Growth band: 1M commit at $0.0012 / 1k tokens (post-discount) => ~ $1,200 / month for committed tokens.
  • If month usage = 1.5M: 1M covered by commit ($1,200) + 500k overage billed at $0.0015 / 1k => $750 => total $1,950.
  • With a 250k flex reserve at $0.0009 / 1k used to cover the first 250k of burst, total becomes ~$1,725.

- Token accounting: note that we bill input+output tokens. For model selection we can provide per-call token estimates if you share a few sample prompts/responses.

I'll bring a short rate-card summary and a calculator to the call.

—Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
